title: ArcBio Continuous RNA Workflow - Pre-PCR Instrument: cDNA Synthesis
author: Opentrons
materials: Bead cleanup and elution with Tris.
Combine RT Master Mix 1 and eluted sample. Pause for off-deck thermocycler steps.

steps.title: Prepare workflow
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 to follow the ArcBio Continuous RNA Workflow (4‑part) for cDNA synthesis, processing up to 96 input RNA samples (Part 2 of 4).

steps.title: Mix EDTA with samples
steps.instruction: Mix EDTA with the input RNA samples from step 1 and transfer the mixture to a deep‑well plate positioned on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Bead cleanup and elution
steps.instruction: Perform bead cleanup on the transferred samples and elute the nucleic acids using Tris buffer.

steps.title: Combine RT Master Mix 1
steps.instruction: Combine RT Master Mix 1 with the eluted sample, then pause the protocol for any off‑deck thermocycler steps.

substeps.instruction: Add RT Master Mix 1 to the eluted sample

steps.title: Add RT Master Mix 2
steps.instruction: Add RT Master Mix 2 to the reaction, then pause for off‑deck thermocycler steps.
